hypothesis: A VIX close above the fixed, conventional 30-point high-stress boundary denotes acute equity-market fear and predicts adverse crypto risk appetite; short the equal-weight crypto basket only after a conservative 1-calendar-day availability lag.

signal.raw_macro_missing_policy: no imputation/no carry-forward of missing source observations
signal.state_persistence: after the 1-day lag, the latest actually observed daily state remains in force until the next lagged observed release

rationale: 30 is an ex-ante conventional high-volatility/stress boundary, not a quantile or threshold fitted to the 2023-2025 crypto sample. A full calendar-day lag prevents same-close use. No threshold search, sign flip, alternate lag, or rescue is permitted if the ex-ante direction fails or if activation is sparse.
gate: Aggregate and every chronological fold must have return > 0 and daily PF > 1 under base costs; aggregate severe and supersevere must each have return > 0 and daily PF > 1; gross cap and invariants must pass. Zero/sparse activation is not grounds to change threshold or lag.
